title: Capacity-constrained partial transport
formal_object: Nonnegative masses a,b; fixed m in (0,min(sum a,sum b)); finite costs C; epsilon>0; Pi>=0 with row<=a, col<=b, sum Pi=m.
assumptions: Remove zero-capacity rows/columns and preserve the published token/event support.
Strictly feasible positive transport exists for the chosen fixed total mass.
Partial transport needs actual token/frame costs and a published native localization endpoint, absent from the current pooled-image carrier.

operations.input: Convex entropy-regularized transport with capacity inequalities
operations.condition: Slater on positive support and fixed m
operations.output: Nonnegative capacity multipliers and free total-mass multiplier characterize the unique optimum.

derivation_steps.statement: Fixing m prevents the zero-transport degeneration; feasibility needs m<=min(sum a,sum b).
derivation_steps.justification: Sum each capacity inequality and compare with the required total.
Complementary slackness is essential; equal-marginal Sinkhorn solves a different primal.

derivation_steps.statement: Let S_i=sum_j exp(-(C_ij+beta_j+nu)/eps). alpha_i=eps max(0,log(S_i/a_i)); beta has the analogous rule; nu=eps log(sum_ij exp(-(C_ij+alpha_i+beta_j)/eps)/m).
derivation_steps.justification: Each formula exactly optimizes its convex dual coordinate/block holding the others fixed; residuals and finite-tolerance termination must be retained.

method_expression: Cyclic dual block minimization of alpha, beta, nu with explicit fixed m, finite iteration budget and primal mass/capacity/KKT residuals; no implementation generated.
distinguishing_prediction: When real events are unmatched, capacity slack permits omitted mass without forcing a full correspondence; benefit requires event cost semantics and native temporal relevance.
falsifier: Full transport under identical costs/frame budget already suffices or selected mass merely deletes hard events; absent event labels is a measurement blocker.
closest_alternative: Existing entropic partial/unbalanced OT; a finite-mass capacity construction is not novel by itself.
decisive_comparison: Only a prelim published-video localization contrast is justified; current three image benchmarks cannot measure the central event hypothesis and are not substituted.
legacy_code_audit: No token/frame exporter, partial-OT source, official video localization scorer or actual cost qualification in r003.
review_limit: Conditional KKT/construction reviewed; source/task feasibility remains pending.
